hypothesis: Pedia current Food listing-loop transfer: marketed consumer mark, stable identity vs descriptors, and original shop variant evidence; no source repo runtime/YAML copying.
instruction:
Recover the consumer brand from explicit source title or description maker evidence. Use the actual named commercial product/line as model, separate explicit title flavour as variant, and omit promotional claims and numeric package sizes. If a named line is not explicit, a distinctive source product name may be used, but do not invent a family. A descriptive food format alone is not automatically the full model identity. Prefer source spelling and concise named identity. A single-brand assortment may have an explicitly named mix or Variety Pack identity; quantities alone never do. Output new_product/new_variant for proposed paths, place for an existing defensible brand-only node, park if no maker evidence.
Before removing listing modifiers, compare their use across the supplied title and description: determine whether they name the edible product's form, an assortment, or its container/quantity. Preserve named product forms in the model and explicitly sold assortments as variants even when no single flavor is specified; remove size/count terms only when they describe packaging or quantity.
When a source-reported consumer brand is an explicit full name, do not shorten it to a title abbreviation. A distributor in the description is not the consumer brand when the product has its own named maker. Preserve the brand within a commercially named product expression when the source names that full branded expression; do not automatically strip the repeated maker from the model. Separate source named assortment/mix or explicitly stated flavour from quantity. Use the source only; do not invent unavailable canonical names.
EXTRACTION PROCEDURE: First locate explicit maker/brand evidence, distinguishing it from distributor or seller statements. Then locate the commercial model designation in title and prose description. Use a short source-attested product-line name when present, retaining any brand words that belong to that named expression; exclude surrounding marketing/category nouns. When title is a plural bulk sales phrase but prose explicitly names the individual product, prefer that attested product designation. Do not singularize trademarks or invent absent canonical/foreign-language aliases. Preserve source wording for named variants and mixes, including all qualifiers named in title, instead of adding a generic flavour absent from the title. A colour/material of a wrapper is not an edible variant unless sold as an explicitly named offering.
ADDITIONAL ORIGINAL SOURCE FIELDS: organizations_json gives organization names with original roles/evidence. Use these names as unverified clues, distinguishing supplier/vendor/distributor from consumer brand. Reconcile maker identity against title/description/source_reported_brand and preserve the full evidenced consumer brand. Do not elevate a distributor, retailer, licensor or variant option to maker automatically. variant_options_json is attribute evidence only; title must still name the child. Apply cross-field product-name alignment: Before finalizing, align complete product-name mentions across the supplied title and description; compare keeping a named line intact against splitting it into model and variant, citing explicit source phrases for the choice. 
PEDIA FOOD LISTING-LOOP PRINCIPLES (general only): The consumer-facing mark under which the item is sold is the brand, not automatically the owner/manufacturer/distributor. Read the source vendor as a clue on a reseller page, but prefer an explicitly named marketed mark when they differ. The stable commercial name is the model; sporadic occasion/dietary wording is not a new model. A flavour of an existing named line is a variant, not another model. Trailing generic type nouns alone do not create a new line. Use ORIGINAL variant_name/variant_options_json as naming evidence only when they explicitly name a real offered flavour/form, never Default Title or unspecified options. A conflicting title wins over a generic description. Same-maker assortment is a source-supported named product/variant, whereas a multi-maker assortment parks. Keep source spelling; do not import unavailable foreign or canonical aliases. These transfer principles are experimental, not changes to frozen gold/scorer.
